fusions.name: Uprooted Boulder
fusions.desc: Tears up a boulder and hurls it at a target up to 7 tiles away for 32 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range. It ignores the target's armour and has a 50% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Fault-Line Pound
fusions.desc: Pounds the ground, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Gravel Wallow
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Jagged Hand-Rock
fusions.desc: Conjures a jagged rock for your hand: your weapon damage rises by 12%, your strikes land 5% faster, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a tick for 3 ticks.
